---
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PLAN DOCUMENT CONTRACT  (machine-readable — the Orchestrator parses THIS block)
# Produced by: SDLC_PLANNER agent (.github/agents/planner.agent.md)
# Consumed by: Orchestrator agent (see .github/plan-output/README.md)
# Field dictionary: .github/plan-output/README.md
# Location:    .github/plan-output/<KEY>/PLAN-<KEY>.md  (alongside the 4 analysis artifacts)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plan_id: PLAN-<KEY>              # PLAN-<jira_key>, unique per story
jira_key: <KEY>                  # e.g. LOAN-123
jira_url: <https://.../browse/<KEY>>
title: <story title from Jira summary>
issue_type: Story                # Story | Bug | Task | Epic
story_points: <n | null>
created: <YYYY-MM-DD>
status: draft                    # draft → approved → in-progress → done   (only a human sets `approved`)
tracks: []                       # subset of [ui, api, qa, deploy] — only tracks with a concrete target

# Sibling analysis artifacts in this folder (produced by the Planner, consumed as task inputs).
artifacts:
  requirements: <KEY>-requirements.md
  spec:         <KEY>-spec.md
  testcases:    <KEY>-testcases.md
  design:       <KEY>-design.md

# Ordered task list. `depends_on` defines execution order; the Orchestrator runs
# ready tasks (all deps done) and PAUSES at any task with `checkpoint: human`.
tasks:
  - id: api-1                    # <track>-<n>, unique
    track: api                   # ui | api | qa | deploy
    agent: API                   # ANGULAR_UI (exists) | API | QA | DEPLOY  → resolved by the Orchestrator
    title: <what this task does>
    inputs: { spec: <KEY>-spec.md }  # free map: spec, tests, design, contract, entity, figma_url, feature_path, angular_version, ui_library, ...
    targets: [ ]                 # real repo paths this task touches
    depends_on: [ ]              # list of task ids that must finish first ([] = ready immediately)
    acceptance: [ ]              # which AC-n this task satisfies (e.g. ["AC-1","AC-2"])
    gate: [ ]                    # checks that must pass to close the task: build | test | lint
    checkpoint: none             # none | human   (human → Orchestrator stops for sign-off after this task)
    est_effort: S                # S | M | L       (directional cost signal)

# Where a human must review before the run continues. `after` = task id (or "plan" for the initial approval).
human_checkpoints:
  - after: plan
    reason: Approve the plan before any sub-agent runs

# The enforcement / escalation / audit layer (scored: governance is a distinct layer, not prose).
governance:
  enforcement:
    - Acceptance criteria for a task must pass before the task closes
    - No deploy task runs unless every QA gate is green
  escalation: On repeated gate failure (2x), halt the track and escalate to the nearest human checkpoint
  audit: Orchestrator appends one timestamped entry per task transition to the "Audit / Run Log" below
---
